instructions: Process assets in table order, one generation per asset.
Include the full Picture Standard followed by the Picture and prompt_clarification.
Attach every listed reference in array order, resolving paths under reference_root.
Inspect every reference and result. Create output parent folders as needed.
Save and verify each FRONT before generating its BACK; attach that saved FRONT.

picture_standard: This is a host (the friendly-spooky chaser) in a kids' co-op escape game for ages 8 and up: grumpy, sneaky and silly, never gory or truly frightening. For a FRONT view one picture is attached: ANOTHER host from the same game - use it ONLY as a guide to the style, proportions and level of detail; design a completely NEW host from this prompt. For a BACK view one picture is attached: the same host seen from directly behind, same pose, every color the same as the front. Clean, simple 3D cartoon toy style: every area one smooth, flat, solid color, with no texture at all - no fabric grain, no fur strands, no stitching, no grime, no wrinkles painted on, no shading or shadows painted on, nothing see-through and nothing glowing. Simple rounded chunky shapes; small details as simple solid shapes close to the body - nothing thin or long sticking out. A big host, about twice as tall as a 10-year-old. No logos, brand marks, printed words, letters, numbers or graphics. Not like any famous character from a film, cartoon, game or advert - a new, original take on a grumpy Christmas couple. Full body standing in an A-pose: arms straight and angled down and away from the body with a clear gap between each arm and the body, hands open, legs apart, feet flat. Centered and filling the whole height, nothing cropped. Plain flat light-gray background, even soft light, no floor shadow. One character only, no text.

assets.picture: FRONT view of Mr Claus, the grumpy Christmas boss: a big, round, barrel-bellied man with rosy cheeks and a big bulbous red nose, a short neat frosty-white beard and bushy white eyebrows pulled into a sulky frown, small sly black eyes; a dark-red suit coat with plain white cuffs and hem (no fur texture) and big square black buttons, a wide black belt with a plain square gray buckle, a small round black sack of coal hanging at his hip, dark-red trousers, chunky black boots; a dark-red floppy cap with a white band and a round white bobble, a gray smudge of soot on the cap and one cheek; big white gloves
